about: The painted backdrop beyond the scroll's end (S7): painting, not models (map/BUILDING.md). No panels. West is the silk's cut edge at u 815: nothing is painted beyond it (map/BUILDING.md rule 4), so mist only (the scroll's blank silk). North: the silk's top edge cuts the compound's roofs and the needle trees, nothing is painted above it: mist. South (below the silk's bottom edge): mist only. East is S6 (the inner city), built: with streaming, S6 is always in S7's window (the section you stand in and one either side), so the page never needs an east panel; alone (?sections=city_end or ?window=0) the seam shows mist.
